name: Galápagos Islands
description: Roughly 1,000 km off Ecuador's coast, the Galápagos are a cluster of volcanic islands where giant tortoises, land iguanas and many finch species live almost nowhere else. Volcanoes here are still active, and three ocean currents meet in the surrounding waters, which teem with marine life. Charles Darwin's 1835 visit helped inspire his theory of evolution by natural selection.
